Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That concludes the proceedings for the fourth T20I. One game to go in the series. The fifth and final game will be played on the 31st of January at 1.30 am IST (8 pm GMT, Previous Day). The build-up will begin much in advance. Do join us for that. Until then, take care and goodbye!

Moeen Ali, the victorious skipper and the Man of the Match, says, there were occasions when they batted well. This is what they exactly wanted, to keep scoring under pressure. Mentions he is happy to share for the team and hopes to get off the mark the same way in the next game. Adds, Adil is getting better as he is getting older. He is a crucial player in the side. Mentions, Rashid is difficult to read and thankfully he was able to get rid of Powell. Adds that the death bowling was fantastic and the bowlers stuck to the basic plan.

Kieron Pollard, the skipper of West Indies, is in for a chat. He says that it was the game of two halves, it didn't spin that much in the first innings. Also, Drakes was a bit unlucky as a couple of edges came off his bowling, he would have probably gone for fewer runs. Mentions that, the nature of a T20 game is that it takes only six balls to change the game. Says that they were slow in the middle while batting and could improve upon. Adds that Adil Rashid has been exceptional and says that tomorrow is going to be a good game.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the innings, England started off well with the blade and Ali made sure the end was fiery as well. This allowed them to cross the 190-run mark. Thanks to a fantastic knock by Ali. West Indies with the reply could not keep with the pressure that was built by the spinners. Eventually, they lost track and came out on the losing end.

What a comeback by England. This is the second time they are coming back from behind in this series. They gave away some runs at the start, but once the spin-trio comes into the middle, runs came in at a slow rate for West Indies. Also, the first four wickets came through the spinners. Moeen Ali was the pick of the bowlers with 2 wickets. In the death over Topley got one as well. The spin did the trick for the visitors.

It looked like West Indies ran into a brick wall. Their opening pair started off nicely with Mayers being the aggressor. The pair had notched up 56 runs in the Powerplay, but in the next 4 overs, they only scored 20 runs and lost 2 wickets as well. There was a period when the West Indies innings had a boundary draught. Enough batters got starts but could not make it count in the end.
A clinical performance by England with the ball. They never let West Indies get ahead in the game. Ali has led his side over the victory line here. West Indies lost their track in the middle overs.
Beaten! That's it! Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Kieron Pollard looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge. ENGLAND WIN BY 34 RUNS!
Another full toss ball, around middle. Darren Bravo pushes it towards long on for a single.
A full toss, wide of off. Darren Bravo swings his bat at it but fails to connect.
Slower ball, length, on middle. Kieron Pollard tucks it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
A low full toss, around middle. Darren Bravo pushes it to long on for a single.
Reece Topley servers a fuller ball, around off. Darren Bravo drills it to the fielder at extra cover.
Shorter ball, outside off. Kieron Pollard looks to pull but misses. 38 needed off the last over now!
FOUR! Just short of Jason Roy at long on! A fuller ball, around off. Kieron Pollard drags it wide of long on, Jason Roy there runs to his right and dives forward and fails to get there. A boundary.
WIDE! Full and wide of off. Kieron Pollard leaves it alone and wide is called.
FOUR! WHIPPED! Chris Jordan goes for the yorker but misses his length and serves a low full toss, on the pads. Kieron Pollard hangs back and whips it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Full in length, around the leg stump. Darren Bravo knocks it towards long on for a single.
Another fuller ball, around off. Kieron Pollard once again drags the ball from the inner half of his bat past mid-wicket for a single.
Very full, around middle. Kieron Pollard drags it from the inner half of his bat towards mid-wicket no run there.
Short, outside off, Bravo pulls it to mid-wicket.
Yorker-length, outside off. Darren Bravo leaves it alone.
Fuller, wide outside off. Bravo looks to chase it but misses.

Length ball, around off. Kieron Pollard back away and tries to cut this away but gets an inside edge on the pitch. Darren Bravo runs from the other end for a single. Reece Topley runs towards the ball and kicks the ball onto the stumps, but misses. That was close!
Darren Bravo is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Reece Topley gets the danger man! West Indies in some sort of trouble! A fuller ball, around middle. Jason Holder advances down the pitch and lofts it towards long on. He miscues his shot and the ball lands straight to Chris Jordan there, who completes the catch comfortably. West Indies are now 5 down.
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Jordan b Reece Topley

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nicley done! A short ball, around middle. Jason Holder steps down and pulls it wide of long on for a boundary.
Reece Topley (2-0-13-0) is back into the attack.
Low full toss, on the pads. Jason Holder clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 54 needed off 18 now!
Full in length, around off. Kieron Pollard knocks it down to long off and rotates the strike.
Very full,a round middle. Jason Holder drills it to long on for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle. Kieron Pollard works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single. Once again, Liam Livingstone slides and makes a good stop! One run taken.

Excellent fielding! Another fuller ball, on the pads. Kieron Pollard whips this towards deep mid-wicket. Liam Livingstone runs to his right and slaps the ball with one hand to keep it away from the ropes! Two runs taken.
Fuller length delivery, around off. Jason Holder lifts it towards long off for a single.
Change of pace this time. A slower ball, shorter in length, outside off. Kieron Pollard looks to pull but misses.
Back of a length, on the body. Jason Holder looks to flick this away but gets a top edge in the vacant mid-wicket area. Single taken.
SIX! PUNISHED! Another fuller delivery, around middle. Jason Holder heaves it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie!
WIDE! Fuller length, wide of off. Jason Holder leaves it alone and a wide is called.
FOUR! Perfect execution! Tymal Mills serves that right in the slot, around off. Jason Holder punches it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Back of a length, around middle. Kieron Pollard swivels and pulls it towards dep square leg for a single.
Shorter ball, around middle. Jason Holder pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tymal Mills comes back into the attack.
Tossed up, full, on middle. Holder gets low and lofts it towards wide long on. The ball lands safely and they take one.
Leg spinner, on off. Pollard taps it to point for a single.
Full and on middle. Holder sweeps it to square leg for one.
WIDE! Full and wide outside the tramline on the off side, Wide called.
SIX! Second one of the over. This is huge. Floated, full and on middle. Holder slog-sweeps it over the wide long on fence.
Short and on off. Holder pushes it to cover.
SIX! Full and on middle. Holder gets low and smokes it over the wide long on fence for a biggie.
Adil Rashid (3-0-12-1) is back into the attack.

FOUR BYES! This one flies. Looped up, full and on off. Pollard presses forward as he looks to defend it out but gets beaten by the turn. The ball goes past the slip fielder and down to the third man fence.
Around off, lofted over point for a single.
Short and on off. Pollard pulls it to square leg for a single.
Kieron Pollard, the skipper of West Indies, comes to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Liam Livingstone has the last laugh here. After being hit for two sixes, Liam Livingstone sends back Pooran. This is a huge, huge wicket for England. Tossed up, full and on off. Pooran miscues it towards long on. Jason Roy runs in and takes a good catch diving forward.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Roy b Liam Livingstone

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! This one is on the roof! Short, on leg. Pooran gets low and slog-sweeps it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum. The umpires begin their search for the new ball.

Slight halt in play. Nicholas Pooran is facing certain issues with his back. The physio is out there to check on him. He seems good to go! Also, the umpires need to replace the ball after that big six from Nicholas Pooran!
WIDE! Slower, wide outside the tramline. Pooran leaves it alone. Wide called.
SIX! BOOM! This should ease some pressure. Tossed up, full and on off. Pooran smacks it over the long on fence for a biggie.
An off-pace, full-length delivery, on off. Holder plays it back to the bowler. This is a brilliant spell by Jordan. They are right on top here.
Jordan fires in a yorker, on off. Holder stays back and digs it out.
Full, on leg. Pooran clips it to long on for just a single. England are giving no pace to the batter to work with.
Back of a length, slower one, on off. Holder pulls it to long on for another single.
Back of a length, on off. Pooran lifts it towards long off for a single. West Indies need boundaries at this moment.
Full length, outside off. Pooran taps it back to the bowler.
Chris Jordan (1-0-9-0) is back into the attack.
Flatter, on the pads. Pooran nudges it to square leg for another single. An excellent over by Liam Livingstone. Only 3 runs off it.
Fuller, on off. Holder taps it to cover for a single.
Full, on leg, defended to mid-wicket.
Tossed up, around off, turning away. Holder goes back and the spin makes it impossible for him to reach it.
Full, outside off. Holder blocks it out.
Outside off, worked to mid off for a single.
Liam Livingstone comes into the attack.
This one turns a mile! Floated, full and on off. Holder leans forward to defend it out but it grips and turns away. The man at first slip gathers it.
Full, on off. Holder blocks it out.
Jason Holder comes to the crease now.

OUT! TIMBER! Adil Rashid does the trick here. He sends back the hero of the last game on a timid score here. Rashid serves a googly, on off. Powell gets completely deceived by the googly. The ball goes through the gate to rattle the stumps. This is a huge wicket for England.
Leg spinner, on off. Powell pushes it to cover.
Short and outside off, Pooran cuts it past backward point for a single.
Full, on leg. Powell flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller again , outside off. Rovman Powell drives it towards cover for a single. West Indies are 76/2 at the halfway mark.
Tosses this one up, full and on middle. Rovman Powell defends it out.
WIDE! Firing it down the leg side. Rovman Powell leaves it alone and a wide is called.
Short and on leg. Pooran goes back and pushes it to long on for one.
Sliding down leg, touch shorter. Rovman Powell tickles it away past the leg slip fielder. James Vince runs across from the fine leg and saves a run for his team. Three runs taken.
Tosses it up, around off and full in length. Nicholas Pooran drives it towards cover for a single.

DRINKS! Moeen Ali is leading with the ball here and he has he taken two crucial scalps here. England have the momentum and would looks to capitalize on that. West Indies, on the other hand, still have some power-hitters up their sleeve, who can turn things around. A partnership can change the trajectory of the game. Rovman Powell joins Pooran in the middle now.

OUT! Moeen Ali strikes once again! West Indies have lost their second wicket now, and it's the other set batsman, Brandon King who has to depart. A fuller ball, around middle. Brandon King shimmies down the pitch and tries to go over long on but does not get to the pitch of the ball and also fails to get hold of his shot. The ball flies and goes towards Philip Salt at long on who takes the catch comfortably.
Commentary.Howout: c Philip Salt b Moeen Ali

Commentary.Commentary: Pushed to cover for a single.
Wrong'un now, on the pads. Brandon King misses his flick and gets rapped on the pads.

NOT OUT! A shout for Stumping! A leg break this time, outside off. Brandon King looks to sweep but misses. Sam Billings collects the ball and whips the bails off. The umpires check for a stumping chance. The reply rolls in and UltraEdge confirms no bat involved. Also, the replays show that Brandon King had his back foot behind the crease.
Is that out? The umpire takes it upstairs to check the stumping. The UltraEdge shows not bat involved. The replays show Brandon King had his back foot behind the crease. He survives.
A googly, around middle. Brandon King stays in his crease and taps it towards point.
Shorter, spinning it in the left-hander. Nicholas Pooran tucks it towards dep mid-wicket for a single
Tosses it up, full in length, around middle. Brandon King pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Tad shorter, around the off pole. Nicholas Pooran pushes it to the fielder at cover. End of a successful over!
Tad quicker, outside off. Nicholas Pooran shows the full face of the bat and defends it out off the back foot.
Loopy ball, full and on middle. Nicholas Pooran leans and blocks it out.
Shorter ball, outside off. Nicholas Pooran hangs back and cuts it towards sweeper cover for a brace. He gets off the mark with that.
Nicholas Pooran comes in at number 3.

OUT! Moeen Ali draws first blood! England have got their first breakthrough! Much needed wicket! A fuller ball, outside off. Kyle Mayers steps down the pitch and looks to go over long off but fails to get the distance. Chris Jordan at long off pouches it safely to dismiss Kyle Mayers.
Commentary.Howout: c Chris Jordan b Moeen Ali

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter ball, around middle. Brandon King pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Moeen Ali (2-0-18-0) is back into the attack now.
Another googly, around off. Kyle Mayers dabs it to short third man.
Shorter ball, on middle. Kyle Mayers pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder runs to his left and puts in a dive to make a good stop. Two runs taken.
A googly this time, outside off. Brandon King, on back foot, cuts it away towards point for a single.
Quicker, outside off. Brandon King pushes it to cover.
Beaten! A leg spinner, full, outside off. Brandon King looks to drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR Easy pickings! Fuller ball, sliding down the leg side. Brandon King tucks it away towards fine leg for a boundary.
Adil Rashid comes into the attack now.
Length ball, firing it on the pads. Kyle Mayers clips it to the fielder at mid-wicket. West Indies are 56/1 at the end of the Powerplay!
Another fuller delivery, around middle. Brandon King pushes it towards mid on and takes a single.
Fuller this time, around the off pole. Brandon King looks to drive this but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Brandon King taps it to the fielder at point.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! A length ball, outside off. Brandon King stays in his crease and punches that through cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Welcome to the attack, Chris Jordan! A shorter ball, wide of off. Brandon King hangs back and cuts it over point for a boundary! 50 up for West Indies!
Chris Jordan comes into the attack.
Good finish to the over by Mills. Full length, wide outside off. Mayers gets deceived by the pace and misses it completely.
A good bumper, on middle and leg. Mayers ducks under it.
An off-pace, short delivery, outside off. Mayers looks to chase it but gets beaten by the pace here.
SIX! This is extraordinary! Fuller, on leg. Mayers comes inside and laps it over the fine leg fence for a maximum.
SIX! This is much better. Mills goes wide yet again, on the shorter side. Mayers cuts it hard and high over the point fence for a maximum.
FOUR! Up and over! Back of a length, outside off. Mayers cuts it over point for a boundary. Mills under pressure from the start.
Tymal Mills comes into the attack.
Short and outside off. Mayers cuts it through covers. The fielder completes the chase and save a boundary. They take three.
SIX! Sweetly struck! Full, on middle and leg. Mayers gets inside the line and smokes it over the wide long on fence.
Around off, Mayers looks to heave across the line but misses.
Full and on off. Mayers gets his sweep to mid on.
On off, played back to the bowler.
Tossed up, around leg. King goes back and pushes it to long on for one.
Back of a length, on middle and leg. Mayers looks to play the hook shot but misses this time.
FOUR! Mayers gets on top of this one. A short ball, on off. Mayers pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Full length, on middle and leg. King flicks it to deep mid-wicket. The initial call was two but they could only get a single.
On the stumps. Mayers works it through mid-wicket for one.
Length, on off. King taps it to cover for a single.
Full length, outside off. Kings leans in and drives it into covers. Philip Salt gets low to his right to make a good stop.
Length, on middle and leg. Mayers pushes it to mid on.
Short and on middle. King pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
Short and on off. King goes back to defend it out.
On the pads, tucked to the leg side for a single.
SIX! BOOM! Touch short, on off. Mayers gets under it and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence.
BEATEN! Tossed up, landing on off and drifting away. Mayers looks to defend it out but misses.
Moeen Ali brings himself into the attack.
Good length, angled across the right-hander. King gets hit above his knee-roll. He get a tad squared up as he looks to defend it out.
A length ball, around middle and leg. King gets an inside edge and it dies onto the deck.
Full length, wide outside off. Mayers gets it off the outside edge but wide of the slips for single.
Full length, on off. King defends it to mid off for a quick single.
FOUR! Down the ground. A low full toss, around off. King slaps it down the ground for a boundary.
A length ball, on middle, this one nips back in. King gets it towards square leg off the inner half.
